new_jobs.title: Electric Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Department: 

Silicon Valley Power (SVP) has proudly served the innovative community of Santa Clara since its inception on July 23, 1896. Over 125 years later, we remain dedicated to providing reliable electricity to our residents and the thriving high-tech sector. 
As a city-owned, not-for-profit electric utility, SVP offers exceptional customer service and competitive rates. We uphold our commitment to sustainability by sourcing over 40% of our electricity from carbon-free renewable resources, including wind, solar, geothermal, and hydroelectric energy, while also capturing local methane gas for electricity production.
At SVP, we are more than just a utility; we are dedicated partners in creating a sustainable future for Santa Clara. We empower our community with energy-efficient solutions while delivering safe, reliable, and affordable services. Join us as we continue to drive innovation and champion sustainability for future generations.
For more information about Silicon Valley Power, please visit the department website.

Silicon Valley Power is recruiting to fill various Electric Program Manager positions in the following specialties: 
Project Management Office 

Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Network Project Manager

Infrastructure Systems Specialist

Engineering

The Position(s): 

Project Management Office
The City of Santa Clara’s Electric Department, Silicon Valley Power (SVP), is seeking an Electric Program Manager – PMO to establish, implement, and lead a Project Management Office within the Electric Technology Services Division. The position will strengthen project and portfolio governance, capacity and resource management, performance reporting, and delivery standards across the Division’s operational and project workstreams.
A key focus of this role will be providing leadership with clear visibility into workload, priorities, available capacity, dependencies, commitments, and risks across both operational and project activities. Because the same technical resources support ongoing operations and project delivery, this visibility will inform decisions regarding prioritization, work sequencing, resource allocation, and the need for supplemental project resources or surge capacity to meet critical commitments. The position will also help advance IT Service Management and ITIL-aligned practices. The ideal candidate will bring strong program, project, portfolio, and organizational change-management skills, along with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Desired Qualifications

Demonstrated experience implementing project portfolio management practices, including demand intake, project prioritization, portfolio balancing, capacity planning, dependency management, benefits realization, and executive portfolio review processes.
Experience managing workload and capacity across both project and operational workstreams, including identifying resource constraints, balancing competing priorities, sequencing work, and determining when supplemental or surge resources are needed.
Knowledge of ITIL 4 and practical experience implementing or improving IT Service Management (ITSM) processes in an operational technology, information technology, utility, government, or other critical-service environment. Experience with ServiceNow ITSM or a comparable ITSM platform is highly desirable.
Experience establishing measurable service-delivery and project-performance metrics, including project health indicators, schedule and budget variance, resource utilization, service-level performance, incident trends, change success rates, customer satisfaction, and benefits realization.

Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Network Project Manager
The position will report to the Systems Support Division within SVP. The Electric Program Manager (Cybersecurity, Infrastructure and Network Project Manager) will serve as a hands-on technical project manager responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving cybersecurity, infrastructure, and network projects that support SVP's modernization of systems and processes.
This position requires a technical project manager who can work effectively with network engineers, cybersecurity professionals, system administrators, infrastructure architects, vendors, consultants, and utility operations personnel. The successful candidate should have sufficient technical depth to understand infrastructure and security designs, identify technical dependencies and risks, facilitate technical decisions, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and drive implementation through completion.

Infrastructure Systems Specialist
The position will report to the Systems Support Division within SVP. The Electric Program Manager (Infrastructure Server Specialist) will serve as a hands-on senior server and infrastructure administrator, leading the administration, security, troubleshooting, and modernization of SVP's Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware, Hyper-V, enterprise storage/SAN, compute, backup/recovery, and core infrastructure services.

Engineering This position will manage portfolio of capital improvement projects that can include new substations, transmission and distribution lines, reconstruction, expansion of existing substations and transmission lines and distribution systems. This position requires hands-on working knowledge of the project management lifecycle, including not limited to initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, and closeout of projects. This position may also manage staff such as but not limited to Senior Electric Utility Engineers, Electric Utility Engineers, interns, electric estimators and designers related to the planning, operation and maintenance of distribution and transmission facilities and SVP’s third-party overhead pole contact program.  The candidate will also assist in the development of budget, standards and specifications, contracts, and training programs. This position will administer procurement contracts, public work contracts and other related contracts related to Capital improvements projects, design, construction, operation, and maintenance of utility projects including electric transmission and distribution facilities and other electrical infrastructure.  This position may stand in for the Electric Division manager of Engineering during times of absence. 
As a member of the City's Unclassified Service, this is an "at-will" position and the incumbent serves at the discretion of the City Manager.

Additional Information: 

Applications must be filled out completely (e.g. do not write “see resume, NA, or personnel file.”). To receive consideration for the screening process, candidates must submit a 1) Cover Letter and 2) Resume. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Job Summary

The Program Manager of Adult & Youth Services provides clinical, operational, and administrative leadership for Adult Mental Health, Child & Adolescent, and First Episode Psychosis (FEP) programs.

This leadership position is responsible for ensuring high-quality, person-centered services while maintaining compliance with CCBHC, IDHS/DMH, Medicaid, payer, accreditation, and organizational standards. The Program Manager oversees clinical documentation, IM+CANS compliance, staff and supervisor performance, referrals, census, productivity, community outreach, and program growth.

The Program Manager ensures clients move efficiently from referral and intake through enrollment, active treatment, and ongoing engagement while supporting strong clinical outcomes and the financial sustainability of assigned programs.

Job Duties

Provide clinical and operational oversight of Adult Mental Health, Child & Adolescent, and FEP programs.
Supervise, coach, and hold Program Supervisors accountable for staff performance, clinical quality, documentation, productivity, and program outcomes.
Review and monitor IM+CANS assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and other clinical documentation for quality, timeliness, medical necessity, and compliance.
Ensure compliance with CCBHC, IDHS/DMH, Medicaid, payer, accreditation, and organizational requirements.
Provide consultation and oversight for complex and high-risk clinical cases.
Oversee the referral process from intake through program assignment, enrollment, and first service to improve access and reduce clients lost to care.
Monitor census, admissions, discharges, engagement, retention, caseloads, and available program capacity.
Develop strategies to increase census and appropriate utilization of revenue-generating clinical services.
Build and maintain referral relationships with schools, hospitals, primary care providers, crisis programs, community organizations, and other partners.
Participate in marketing, networking, outreach, and community engagement activities.
Monitor staff productivity, billable services, and documentation practices affecting reimbursement.
Collaborate with Intake, Quality, Billing, Finance, and senior leadership to address operational and performance barriers.
Review program data and implement quality improvement and corrective action plans when performance expectations are not met.
Support recruitment, onboarding, training, development, performance evaluation, and retention of staff.
Promote integrated care and collaboration among behavioral health, psychiatry, primary care, crisis services, and community resources.

SMART GOALS

Clinical Quality & Compliance

Within the first 90 days, establish a consistent monitoring process for IM+CANS assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and required clinical documentation across assigned programs, identifying compliance gaps and implementing corrective actions to improve timeliness, quality, and regulatory readiness.

Access, Census & Engagement

Within the first six months, evaluate referral-to-service workflows across Adult Mental Health, Child & Adolescent, and FEP programs and implement measurable strategies to improve referral conversion, timely enrollment, client engagement, retention, census, and appropriate program utilization.

Productivity & Program Performance

Within the first six months, establish and monitor performance expectations for Program Supervisors and their teams related to productivity, billable services, documentation, caseload capacity, and program outcomes, using performance data to develop improvement plans when expectations are not achieved.

Qualifications

Overview

InterSystems is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of large-scale, complex technology projects for enterprise customers.

This role will primarily support healthcare interoperability and integration initiatives, while also managing technical projects across other industries. The ideal candidate combines strong project leadership skills with sufficient technical knowledge to effectively engage with architects, developers, infrastructure teams, business stakeholders, and executive sponsors.

The Project Manager will be responsible for project governance, scope, schedule, risk management, customer relationships, and overall project success throughout the entire project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of large and complex customer projects.
Define and manage project scope, milestones, deliverables, schedules, and resource plans.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams and ensure alignment across customer and internal stakeholders.
Establish effective project governance, reporting, decision-making, and escalation processes.
Identify, manage, and communicate project risks, issues, dependencies, and changes.
Monitor project financial performance, including forecasting, resource utilization, and effort control.
Maintain clear communication with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams.
Support pre-sales and project planning activities as needed.
Lead go-live readiness, transition to support, project closure, and lessons learned activities.
Ensure compliance with project methodologies, quality standards, and organizational policies.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of project management experience delivering large-scale technology projects.
Proven experience leading customer-facing projects with multiple stakeholders, workstreams, and delivery teams.
Experience managing the full project lifecycle, from initiation through go-live and closure.
Strong skills in project governance, planning, forecasting, risk management, and stakeholder management.
Experience leading cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both executive and technical audiences.
Solid understanding of software implementation, systems integration, and enterprise IT environments.
Ability to discuss technical topics with architects, developers, infrastructure, and integration teams.
Professional proficiency in English and Portuguese.
Willingness to travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing healthcare IT, interoperability, or digital transformation projects.
Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7, FHIR, IHE, APIs, and related integration technologies.
Experience with Hospital Information Systems (HIS), Electronic Health Records (EHR), or healthcare integration platforms.
Experience working in highly regulated industries.
Spanish language skills.

Ability to use enterprise AI and generative AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, to support project planning, risk and dependency analysis, meeting and document summarization, status reporting, stakeholder communication, and decision-making. Strong understanding of responsible AI principles, including data privacy, information security, confidentiality, transparency, human oversight, and the ethical use of AI. Experience applying AI to improve project delivery processes, including identification of project risks, analysis of action items, resource and capacity planning, requirements management, quality reviews, and automation of repetitive project management activities.
Familiarity with AI use cases in healthcare interoperability and digital health environments, including the responsible use of AI alongside InterSystems HealthShare, HL7 FHIR, clinical data repositories, EMPI, integration platforms, and healthcare analytics solutions.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, or other related field.

SAFe, Agile, Scrum, ITIL, or healthcare technology certifications are considered a plus.

Description

Intelligence Analyst III

At Celestar, a B&A Company, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients and with each other as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love for you to join our team!

Job Summary

Celestar, a B&A Company, is looking for an Intelligence Analyst III
in support of the Army Research and Technology Protection Center. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a great team while supporting…

Responsibilities

Conduct All-Source intelligence analytic assessments, which will address the impact of the compromised cyber data on Army technologies and programs.
Produce and deliver an IR to annotate their findings. The Contractor shall coordinate, track, compile, and produce ARTPC Intelligence Impact Statements per ARTPC CIDA SOP.
Respond to Request for Information (RFI) from Government Security Specialists and Contractor Engineers to support ARTPC formal assessments.
Submit RFIs to the CIDA Case Manager, who will review the RFI with the requester and triage the RFI with the ARTPC Senior Intelligence Officer (SIO), the
Assistant Secretary of the Army (Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology) (ASA (ALT)), Program Protection Directorate CIDA Lead, and, if required, with external CIDA IC partners for validation; RFIs are to be submitted to the CIDA Case Manager at least 15 business days before the date of the ARTPC formal assessment and must be accompanied with a key word list for the program/technologies being assessed.
Assign a CIDA analyst(s) to support the validated RFI.
CIDA's response to a validated RFI will be provided before the formal assessment IAW the timeline agreed to with the requestor; if the original RFI cannot be validated (i.e., supported) the CIDA Case Manager will work with the requestor to refine the RFI so that it can be supported in agreement upon timeline and in a format consistent with the requestor's needs.
Maintain a record of all RFI requests and responses to support CIDA case management, metrics, reporting, and workload analysis.
Review Army Damage Assessment Reports’ Case Data and conduct initial analysis of compromised cyber information to identify Army equities (i.e., triage – searching compromised data for sensitive information on Army programs, technologies, and warfighting capabilities).
Reviews and analyses will be conducted using analytical tools provided by the DC3 and the Damage Assessment Management Office (DAMO) laboratory; after triage, the CIDA Triage Analyst shall produce and deliver an Incident Report (IR) to annotate their findings.
Conduct incident reviews, data analysis, and reporting within prescribed timelines IAW the ASA(ALT) CIDA SOP.
DC3 CIDA Intelligence Analysts shall, upon completion of all PEO/Program Management (PM)/Technology Office damage assessments, produce a CIDA Report (CIDAR) for each IR that was produced for a CIDA case that includes PM/Technology Office findings and Intelligence and Counterintelligence analysis gathered by the entire Intel/CIDA team per ASA(ALT) CIDA Lead guidance and the ASA(ALT) CIDA Standard Operating Procedure (SOP).
Develop and monitor case assignments, tasks, and production schedules, and manage projects/production of supervised CIDA analysts. develop and monitor case assignments, tasks, and production schedules, and manage projects/production of supervised CIDA analysts.
Coordinate tasking with CIDA Triage (DC3) (Linthicum, MD), NCIJTF (Chantilly, VA), United States Army Counterintelligence Command (USACIC) CIDA (Fort Meade, MD), National Ground Intelligence Center (NGIC) CIDA (Fort Meade, MD, or Charlottesville, VA), and the DoD Chief Information Officer (CIO) Defense Industrial Base (DIB) Cybersecurity (CS) CIDA (Arlington, VA) representatives at the above secure work facilities.
Coordinate, track, compile, and produce CIDARs per the ASA(ALT) CIDA SOP. The Contractor shall schedule, conduct, and document an After-Action Report (AAR) after completion and delivery of each intelligence impact statement to the Government. The AAR shall identify lessons learned and identify process improvement changes that need to be incorporated into CIDA SOPs. Participants in the AAR shall include, at a minimum: CIDA Case Manager, Lead Intelligence Analyst for the case, ARTPC SIO, and ASA(ALT) CIDA Lead.
Conduct CI analysis and produce a CI assessment that specifically addresses the impact that the compromised cyber data will have on Army technologies and programs.
Produce quarterly and annual CIDA reports that cover trends, ongoing activities, and findings for the applicable quarter or year, IAW the ASA(ALT) CIDA SOP.
The analytic assessments must be submitted for approval by NGIC.
Participate in ASA(ALT), PEO, PM, or Technology Office Integrated Product Team (IPT)/SME data reviews convened at either DC3 or PEO/PM worksite locations outside of the National Capital Region (i.e., Remote CIDAs) to determine the overall impact a loss of unclassified data has on Army programs and technologies.
Provide an overview of the CIDA process, detail what is expected of SMEs, demonstrate use of the analysis tool, assist SMEs with reviewing data, and conduct an AAR after the IPT/SME review/remote CIDA IAW the ASA(ALT) CIDA SOP.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree or 8 years of additional intelligence analysis experience instead of a degree AND formal all-source intelligence analysis training (e.g., Army intelligence analyst MOS training or DoD equivalent)
Eight (8) to ten (10) years of experience as an intelligence analyst.
Special Skills: A working understanding of computer network terminology and architecture, and familiarity with computer forensic terminology/techniques, and the NIST cybersecurity framework and cybersecurity standards.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills to effectively interface with senior military officials, managers, and subordinates.
Valid US Passport.

TS/SCI

Position Overview

The Penetration Tester at is a critical member of the Application Security team, focused on identifying, validating, and resolving security vulnerabilities across our cloud infrastructure and applications. You will lead technical security assessments, including application-layer and network-layer penetration testing, to ensure all information assets are secured against evolving threats. This role is vital for maintaining our security posture and ensuring remediation efforts are effectively prioritized and executed.

Key Responsibilities

Perform comprehensive manual and automated application-layer penetration tests to identify vulnerabilities, adhering to industry standards and internal methodologies.
Conduct network-layer penetration tests encompassing all components supporting network functions and operating systems.
Validate segmentation and scope-reduction controls at least annually and after any significant changes to ensure isolation of the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE).
Triage and validate vulnerabilities reported through bug bounty program.
Document and risk-rate all findings, providing actionable remediation guidance to engineering and product teams.
Verify the correction of exploitable vulnerabilities through re-testing and post-remediation assessments.
Collaborate with external 3rd party security firms on penetration testing and threat hunting exercises.
Ensure all security assessments and remediation activities meet compliance and regulatory obligations (e.g., PCI DSS, SOC).

Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, ethical hacking, or application security engineering.

Comprehensive knowledge of network protocols and security concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, and IPSEC.
Strong experience with security testing tools (e.g., BurpSuite Enterprise, SAST, DAST, and IAST).
Working knowledge of OWASP security fundamentals and API identity/access management (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT).
Ability to work with high autonomy and communicate technical security findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Relevant information security certification(s) such as OSCP, CEH, OSWE, or CISSP.

Direct experience managing or triaging a public bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, BugCrowd).
Experience leveraging Slack/ChatOps to automate security tasks or reporting.
Experience with cloud orchestration and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Google Deployment Manager).
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tooling like Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC2, or CCPA.

Location: Onsite, Austin, TX 78751 (No Remote — Local Texas candidates only)

Position Overview

We are seeking one (1) Network Security Analyst 1 to join a Texas state agency's Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC). This role performs advanced cybersecurity analysis and threat triage — continuously monitoring, triaging, analyzing, and prioritizing security alerts; investigating suspicious activity; identifying potential threats; and coordinating incident response to protect agency information systems, networks, and data. The analyst serves as a primary point of contact for security event analysis, threat identification, and incident escalation. Entry-to-early-career level: relies on established guidelines and procedures, with limited independent judgment required.

Responsibilities

Monitor, analyze, and triage cybersecurity alerts from SIEM, EDR, cloud security, email security, identity protection, and network security platforms
Conduct initial investigations of security events to determine severity, scope, impact, and risk to agency operations
Identify, validate, and prioritize potential incidents, escalating confirmed threats to Incident Response, Threat Hunting, or SOC Engineering per established procedures
Correlate security events across multiple sources — endpoints (EDR), firewalls, IDS/IPS, cloud services, authentication systems, and threat intelligence feeds
Review and analyze indicators of compromise (IOCs), suspicious network activity, phishing emails, malware detections, and anomalous user behavior
Document investigations, findings, and response actions in ticketing/case management systems
Assist with incident containment, eradication, and recovery, coordinating with technical teams and stakeholders

Support continuous improvement of threat detection through alert tuning, process refinement, threat intelligence integration, and false-positive trend identification
Perform vulnerability assessment reviews and evaluate identified vulnerabilities for risk/remediation prioritization

3+ years each in: triaging security alerts, analyzing security events, documenting incident investigations, cybersecurity frameworks, incident response processes, threat detection methodologies, cybersecurity operations, security monitoring, incident response, threat detection, security investigations, and related cybersecurity disciplines

One or more of: CompTIA Security+, GIAC GCIH, GIAC GCIA, Certified SOC Analyst (CSA), Microsoft SC-200, or other GIAC/SOC-related certifications

new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team:
Our Trust & Safety team's commitment is to keep our online community safe. We have invested heavily in human and machine-based moderation to remove harmful content quickly and often before it reaches our general community.
As our international organization expands rapidly and becomes more complex, so too does the regulatory and legal environment. We are therefore expanding the Trust and Safety Regulatory Compliance team to partner with business, legal and compliance teams to implement and deliver content and safety regulations, execute legal and regulatory obligations, and monitor compliance.
The Regulatory Delivery and Transparency (RDT) function aims to be the strategic partner of TikTok departments, starting with the Trust & Safety (T&S) team, working in close partnership with relevant Legal and Compliance teams, to best address content and safety regulatory requirements applicable to TikTok.
The Regulatory Compliance team will facilitate the execution of regulatory projects across critical departments (including Trust and Safety, Legal, TikTok Product, E-Commerce, Monetization) with a forward focus mindset for continuous improvement. This role will play a critical part within the team, with responsibility for programme management and the ongoing monitoring of relevant regulatory obligations.
As Program Manager, you will manage large-scale regulatory programs from scoping through execution, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of obligations, risk assessments, and regulatory responses. You will design and implement scalable compliance frameworks, drive controls and assurance infrastructure, and support internal audit readiness while partnering closely with Legal, Compliance, and cross-functional teams. This role requires strategic thinking, operational excellence, and strong communication with executive leadership to surface risks, shape compliance priorities, and foster continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:
- Program Management of Regulatory and Legal Obligations:
- Lead and manage large-scale regulatory compliance projects from initial scoping to completion.
- Strategically plan and execute initiatives to prepare for forthcoming regulatory requirements.
- Coordinate resources across Trust & Safety and other functions, assessing resource capacity and planning deliverables to ensure timely project completion.
- Oversee ongoing obligations, maintain issue logs, and conduct gap analyses.
- Ensure the prompt delivery of information for Requests for Information and other regulatory interactions, securing contributions and reviews from relevant teams.
- Controls and Assurance Infrastructure Development:
- Lead control monitoring activities, investigate deviations, and ensure the effectiveness of controls in partnership with Legal and Compliance teams.
- Implement and monitor the progress of recommendations from internal and external audits.
- Engage in risk assessments, and implement and track mitigation strategies identified in the risk assessment processes.
- Compliance Framework Development:
- Facilitate the strategic development and execution of compliance frameworks that address both current and emerging regulatory challenges.
- Bridge gaps between various internal teams to ensure seamless integration of compliance standards and practices.
- Continuously seek opportunities to enhance regulatory processes and frameworks, leveraging insights and feedback to foster an environment of continuous improvement within Trust and Safety.
- Leadership and Communication:
- Regularly communicate with and update executive leadership in partnership with Legal and Compliance teams on project statuses, compliance gaps, strategic decision-making, and prioritization.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)
- Proven program management experience with a strong ability to independently lead and deliver complex, cross-functional programs end to end.
- Deep understanding of global regulatory frameworks such as the EU Digital Services Act (DSA), Online Safety Act(s), and other emerging regulations impacting digital platforms with a focus on APAC regulations.
- Track record of planning, coordinating, and executing strategic initiatives across multiple regions, with the ability to both think at a high level and execute tactically.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex information, conduct risk assessments, and make strategic decisions within a dynamic environment
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging and influencing executive leadership in high-ambiguity environments.
- Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams, aligning diverse stakeholders around shared compliance goals. Flexibility to work across time zones and support global collaboration.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- 5+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, risk management, audit, or a related field—ideally within the technology, internet, or digital services sector.
- Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with a natural curiosity and drive for continuous improvement.
- Experience in Trust & Safety, Product, or Policy teams within a tech company, with an understanding of industry-specific regulatory challenges.
- Familiarity with compliance assurance frameworks, systemic risk assessments, or control monitoring in a highly regulated environment.
- Experience preparing for audits or managing responses to regulatory inquiries or RFIs.

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Acquisition and Technology Analysis Group within JOID specializes in the application of multi-disciplinary analytic skills to support multiple clients within the Department of War (DoW). These clients include the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering (OUSW(R&E)), Office of the Under Secretary of War for Acquisition and Sustainment (OUSW(A&S)), DARPA, the Joint Staff, and USINDOPACOM. SPA provides critical decision support to enabling and executing a strategy of technological superiority and enabling the delivery and sustainment of secure, resilient, and preeminent capabilities to the warfighter quickly and cost effectively. Our team of experienced military, technical, and operations research analysts is skilled in evaluating military problems, identifying the driving factors, devising innovative approaches, collecting applicable data, developing necessary software tools, and performing thorough and timely assessments to inform technology and acquisition governance decisions to ensure U.S. military forces retain military superiority in the future.

We have an immediate need for a Military Operations Analyst to provide onsite support out of Alexandria, VA. This need welcomes disciplines in operations research analysis, intelligence analysis, or science and technology analysis.

Responsibilities

We are seeking a passionate and dedicated professional interested in providing technical, data-driven support combined with strategy-informed analysis of defense-related topics. Apply a passion for solving challenging, unstructured, and time-critical problems in both leadership and supporting roles. Participate in analyses, assessments, and workshops that integrate technical, operational, and programmatic aspects across various elements of the DoW. The individual will support cross-functional, high-performance teams conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis, including wargaming, to inform decision makers at the highest levels of the government, including the Secretary of War, Congress, and the White House. Candidates can expect to manage multiple tasks concurrently, often with constrained timelines. Tasks may be aligned to the individual’s expertise and interests but will often require individuals to rapidly learn and apply new knowledge and skills. Successful candidates will quickly be rewarded with leadership opportunities and direct engagement with external clients and stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of related work experience.
Demonstrated experience developing and presenting military operations analytic findings to senior leadership.
Self-motivated individual with a strong work ethic, time-management, and interpersonal skills; able to work well individually and as part of a team.
Proficient in the MS Office suite of products.
Ability to work fully onsite based on client needs.
Active TS/SCI eligible clearance.

Desired

Master’s degree.
Demonstrated experience in the following areas:
Applying intelligence data on near-peer adversary capabilities.
Assessing the operational impact of planned or conceptual weapon systems.
Analyzing implications of technology policy.
Analyzing DoW acquisition processes.
Supporting DoW wargames, tabletop exercises, or workshops.
Supporting international collaboration efforts.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager (Bengali Speaking), Trust & Safety
new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team
At Market Risk Management team (MRM), we focus on addressing risks that emerge between global safety frameworks and the regional political, regulatory, and cultural realities of individual markets. By combining market-level data, our market expertise and cross-functional insights, we develop tailored strategies to manage Trust & Safety risk, protect users, and help ensure that global safety approaches remain effective across diverse markets.

About the role
Our Market Risk Management team identifies and qualifies risks in our regional communities, collaborating cross-functionally to address and prevent potential emerging risks. As a Program Manager, you will ensure that our policies, programs and systems work together to protect users and prevent abuse across our many features in the Bangladesh market, and across APAC region. You will provide critical market-level expertise, improving safety and driving strategic direction to foster trust within and outside the Trust and Safety department. You will initiate and drive projects and operational changes, advocate for policy changes, and define new processes. You will coordinate with specialists from public policy, legal, communications, product, operations and policy to deliver results.

What will I be doing?
- Produce internal reports on public perception and identified risks to inform mitigation initiatives, identify trends and work cross-functionally to develop solutions and increase our ability to mitigate and reduce the impact of emerging risks across our lines of business.
- Craft risk prevention process and strategy for the Bangladesh market on TikTok platforms with a focus on safety issues such as Youth Safety, Hate, Cyber bullying, etc.
- Work closely with cross-functional partners both inside and outside Trust and Safety (for example Content Policy, Product Management, Data Analytics, Operations, Public Policy and Communications) to identify, assess and resolve safety-related gaps or issues in our products, promote community well-being and user safety with optimization of product features and product strategy.
- Work on initiatives across various features such as Video, Live, comments, follow/like, accounts, etc. with both qualitative and quantitative approaches to detect potential risks in the community, then craft features and strategies to mitigate these risks. This means initiating and driving project definition and scoping, as well as implementation and execution with cross functional stakeholders.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong understanding of the User Generated Content (UGC) social platforms, as well as the regional political, regulatory and cultural landscape in APAC.
- High oral and written proficiency in Bengali is required as this role will cover Bengali-speaking markets
- Strong knowledge about Trust and Safety issues, operations and challenges.
- You have program/project or product management experience, ideally within a safety/risk control/anti-spam strategy environment. As a result of this you display excellent time management and problem-solving skills.
- You are comfortable with large volumes of data and able to do in-depth data analysis, interpretation and reporting, for example, using Excel features such as Pivot tables, Functions, Charts, etc. Familiarity with SQL a bonus
- You are able to work in a high tempo environment, adapt, respond to day-to-day challenges of the role.
- You practise resilience and commitment to self-care to manage the emotional demands of the role.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Expertise in the APAC region and knowledge of the region's culture.
- At least 3 years' experience with T&S and user-generated content (UGC) platforms.

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Operations Analyst
to join our RCM Global Operations
team. This individual will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of key processes and data, supporting our mission to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of healthcare providers.

This is a high-impact role requiring extreme attention to detail, a focus on quality, and the ability to work across different functions to maintain the highest standards. The role requires a commitment to excellence, the ability to handle ambiguity, and a passion for continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

Quality Assurance and Documentation: Conduct quality assurance checks on operational processes, ensuring that all details are correct and there are zero errors.
Process Adherence: Follow detailed processes meticulously and ensure documentation is comprehensive and up-to-date.
Data Analysis: Analyze large datasets and perform quality checks using SQL and other tools to identify discrepancies, optimize processes, and support business decisions.
Instruction Creation: Write detailed instructions and process documents, ranging from simple to complex, to guide internal teams effectively.
Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively in both written and verbal formats, ensuring that complex topics are explained in an easily understandable manner.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with different teams, such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Account Management, to uphold quality standards and solve emerging issues.

What You Have

Experience: 2–3 years of experience in engineering or a data analysis related technical role.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
Extreme Attention to Detail: Ability to spot discrepancies and ensure accuracy in all aspects of the role.
SQL Proficiency: Experience with SQL for data querying and analysis, including working with large datasets to maintain data integrity.
Strong Documentation Skills: Ability to create, maintain, and follow detailed process documentation.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of explaining complex topics clearly.
Ownership and Accountability: A mindset of taking full ownership of responsibilities and a commitment to high-quality output.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage ambiguity effectively.

Firm Overview

Star Mountain is a rapidly growing, specialized private investment firm focused on the large and less competitive lower middle-market ("LMM"), comprised of businesses that generally have between $5 million and $50 million in annual EBITDA. Star Mountain employs three complementary strategies: (i) private credit, (ii) private equity and (iii) secondary private credit and private equity fund investing, all focused within the U.S. LMM. Star Mountain’s track record, business model, growth trajectory and award-winning culture provide compelling career opportunities for driven and talented individuals. Culture is a core principle which includes long-term alignment of interest with 100% of U.S. employees participating in investment profits.

Star Mountain has ~$4.5 billion in assets under management (committed capital including debt facilities as of 10/31/25) and expects strong continued growth based on its performance, distinctive investment approach and its diversified investor base of domestic and global institutions (including public pensions, corporate pensions, insurance companies, commercial banks, endowments, foundations and family offices) and individuals. Star Mountain values team players with positive, solutions-based attitudes complemented by a strong work ethic and is heavily committed to long-term training and career development. Star Mountain is employee-owned with material long-term wealth creation opportunity for dedicated, entrepreneurial professionals. Dynamic team of 120+ full-time people and 40+ Senior Advisors / Operating Partners. The senior team has an average of 30 years of investment experience including prior leadership experience at Blackstone / GSO, Fortress, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan and Merrill Lynch.

Position Description

The Data Operations Analyst is a firmwide role at the center of Star Mountain’s data infrastructure. The role supports the entire firm in its data operations work— keeping the systems of record accurate, current, and decision-ready as the firm scales toward $10 billion+ in assets under management. You will:

Primary responsibility includes hands on updating of data in the firms CRM and ERP Systems with the goal of keeping the data in the systems as up to date, accurate, and real time. Included in this are record creation, updating, deduplication, standardization, enrichment, and synchronization-error resolution
Maintain and produce recurring firm reports and trackers: weekly activity and pipeline reports, KPI dashboards, invoice trackers, portfolio reporting inputs, and executive rundown data
Support executive and investor-facing workflows with accurate underlying data: meeting and interaction logging, contact-card accuracy, tear-sheet fact checking, conference and target-list data builds
Absorb and industrialize data workstreams transitioning from the firm’s offshore administrative vendor — documenting each process, tightening quality standards, and identifying automation opportunities
Partner with the Enterprise Infrastructure team on data-quality initiatives supporting the firm’s migration to a unified data lakehouse (Microsoft Fabric / Omni BI) and AI-enabled reporting
Add value to other aspects of Star Mountain’s overall business as an aligned partner assisting in building a leading private investment business

Qualifications

0–3 years of full-time relevant experience in data management operations, business analytics, CRM administration, financial services operations, or an equivalent internship track; recent graduates in business analytics, information systems, finance, or related fields encouraged to apply
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel; working familiarity with CRM / ERP platforms; exposure to SQL, Power BI, or comparable reporting tools a plus
Exceptional attention to detail — the role’s core product is data the firm’s leadership can trust without re-checking
Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage recurring deliverables, competing priorities, and defined turnaround standards
Clear written and verbal communication; comfort interacting with senior executives and documenting processes
Discretion and sound judgment handling confidential executive, investor, and portfolio information
Team player with a positive, solutions-based attitude and a strong work ethic; strong culture carrier

Timing: Immediate.

Location: In-person, based in Tampa, Florida.

Compensation

The exact salary will be determined based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and performance during the selection process. Employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and other economics. Total compensation may vary by role, location, department, and individual performance. The firm is 100% employee owned providing for material economic wealth creation opportunity.

Benefits

Star Mountain Capital is committed to a healthy and engaged workforce. Our benefits are constantly evolving to support our employees’ needs today and in the future. We offer a highly competitive medical, dental, and vision package. Select other benefits include: 50% coverage on monthly gym memberships, a cell phone stipend, tuition support of job-related designations and learning and development opportunities, and other bespoke benefits.

If your resume is a match for the role you’ve applied for or other potential opportunities, we will reach out to start the conversation. If you do not hear from us immediately, please understand that we are carefully reviewing all applications and will keep your resume on file for future opportunities that align with your experience and qualifications.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND REQUIREMENTS

Contribute to the design of RWE studies, including protocol development, ability to lead statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and other key study documents with minimal/modest supervision; must be able to lead SAP development without supervision for “straightforward” studies, e.g., treatment patterns, purely descriptive studies.
Apply comprehensive knowledge of real-world data sources (e.g., claims, EMR/EHR, registries, omics data, wearable data, PROs) to inform study design, feasibility assessments, and methodological decisions.
Strong fluency in at least one of SAS or R is mandatory.
Perform advanced statistical analyses using SAS, R, Python, SQL, and/or other appropriate tools, ensuring data quality, reproducibility, traceability, and methodological rigor.
Develop operational definitions, code lists, and analytical specifications aligned with study objectives and industry standards.
Prepare high-quality tables, figures, and listings (TFLs) and contribute to study reports, manuscripts, and client deliverables with clear interpretation of findings and articulation of limitations.
Experience in providing client-facing support, including presenting planning and project updates, explaining methodologies, addressing technical questions, and contributing to strategic discussions.
Demonstrate a consulting-oriented approach by proactively identifying risks, proposing solutions, and adapting to evolving client needs.
Manage programming timelines and analytical workstreams across multiple concurrent projects; communicate progress, risks, and mitigation strategies effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
Occasional support of proposal development, desk research, and exploratory analyses as needed.

Qualification Requirements

Master’s degree or higher in Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, Public Health, Health Economics, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience (to demonstrate experience, explicit supporting evidence is required).
5 years (minimum of 3 years) of project-based experience conducting RWE research using secondary healthcare data sources (e.g., claims, EMR/EHR, registries, hospital databases, lab/genomic data, wearable data, PROs).
5 years (minimum of 2 years in a consulting setting) of hands-on statistical programming experience (e.g., SAS, R, Python, SQL) in a research or consulting setting.
Strong understanding of RWE methodologies, observational study designs, bias and confounding control methods, and data governance considerations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with client-facing experience and preparing deliver-ready results and presenting to stakeholders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight timelines.
Demonstrated consulting mindset with the ability to translate analytical results into strategic insights and practical recommendations.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

Responsible for designing, executing, and delivering high-quality real-world evidence (RWE) research to support client decision-making across clinical, regulatory, and market access contexts. This role requires a strong consulting mindset, comprehensive knowledge of real-world data (RWD) sources and methodologies, and the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights. This individual will independently manage analytical workstreams, contribute to study design and methodological strategy, collaborate effectively with cross-functional and client-facing teams, and deliver results with efficiency and quality. They should be able to independently be the biostatistics lead for some study types.

Project Lifecycle & Hygiene

This is the core administrative function. The Project Manager owns the “source of truth.”
Daily auditing of the Asana board to ensure all projects are on track and deliverables are going out on time.
Ensuring analysts are updating their project status, correctly tagging projects, and accurately tracking their hours.
Enforcing the inclusion of start dates and due dates on all tasks.
Ensuring no ticket is marked “Complete” until the project brief and final deliverable links are attached.
Creating and maintaining Asana task templates for recurring deliverables (e.g., weekly performance reports, campaign wrap-ups) to ensure consistency.

Intake & Triage

Support the Analytics Lead in managing the flow of work from YouTube Social to Tellagence.
Reviewing all incoming requests (via Google Forms and Sheets) to ensure a brief is present before it is assigned to an analyst.
Checking that the brief contains clear business questions, data sources, and timelines.
Partnering with the Analytics Lead to prioritize new requests against current workload.
Supporting the translation of project briefs into Asana in order to assign work to analysts.

Resource Planning & Allocation

Support the transition from task management to people and capacity management.
Maintaining a forward-looking view of analyst availability (e.g., who is open next week vs. who is heavily allocated).
Flagging burnout risks to leadership when an analyst is over-allocated for consecutive weeks.
Tracking analyst time spent per Product Area (YTTV, Core, Foundation, YTMP).
Reconciling actual hours worked against the client retainer and allocation model to identify over-utilized Product Areas.

Squarespace Analytics
Hubspot Reporting

Strategic Value-Add (Preferred, Not Required)

Proactively suggesting ways to reduce the number of meetings or simplify intake processes.

Maintaining team documentation (SOPs) and organizing the shared Google Drive to ensure historical reports are accessible.
Managing scope creep by assessing the impact of new requests on active timelines and communicating trade-offs to stakeholders.

You'll be the primary technical point of contact for the field, the main line of communication with GCs on-site, and you'll help hire and train the project managers who take on individual territories as we grow. This is an individual contributor role, with the opportunity to grow into people management as the team scales.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Visit active job sites across multiple concurrent projects, tracking each one's construction stage and ensuring standards, schedules, and deadlines hold.
Lead communication of project design to the field team, and work with the design team on revisions.
Serve as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries from the field, and as the escalation point for GC communications on every site.
Own all project-related group chats — oversight, not just membership.
Aggregate and organize ongoing material requests from the field team.
Create and maintain a punch list for every active project, and run onboarding standard calls with all newly hired project leads.
Evaluate technicians and project leads for promotion or termination.
Participate in interviewing, hiring, and training technicians, leads and project managers as we add territory coverage.

HOW WE WORK

We deploy in occupied buildings on contractor timelines — what isn't documented or enforced doesn't happen.
You set the method. How you enforce KPIs is your call- daily logs, weekly reports, project photos, chat oversight, onboarding decks, training manuals. We care that it works and that it scales.
Problems travel up, not sideways. We'd rather hear it early from you than late from the field.
Write it down. Decisions, site conditions, and contact history live in writing, not in memory.
Standards aren't negotiable. A site that passes because nobody checked is a site that fails later.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-haves

5+ years managing construction, low-voltage, or network infrastructure projects with a high volume of concurrent sites.
Demonstrated experience building process from scratch- be ready to walk us through one you designed and what it fixed.
Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, RFIs, and submittals.
Working knowledge of structured cabling standards, IDF layout, and CCTV/access control installation.
Track record holding field teams and GCs accountable to schedule and spec.
Based in the New York area; able to travel regularly to all active project sites.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on an unrestricted, ongoing basis. Younity does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future for this role.
OSHA 10 certification.
Based in the New York metro area; able to travel regularly to all active project sites.

Nice-to-haves

OSHA 30 or other advanced safety certifications are a plus.
Bilingual English/Spanish.
Low-voltage systems certificates (Brivo, URC, Dormakaba etc.)

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Anticipated base salary of $140,000-$160,000, depending on skills and experience.
401(k) with company match.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Generous paid time off.

ABOUT YOUNITY

Younity provides a leading digital platform for advanced connectivity in multi-dwelling unit (MDU) residential buildings. We deliver a smart, reliable, and secure wireless network that is easy to deploy and backed by exceptional service. Residents enjoy lightning-fast, secure, and affordable WiFi throughout their building without the need for in-unit installation.
We also design, install, and support the low-voltage systems that make these buildings run: access control, CCTV, A/V, intercom, and more. Delivering both the network and the systems that sit on it means our clients get one accountable partner instead of four, and residents get connected building technology that actually works together.
Behind the scenes, we're an automation-first company. We automate network monitoring, diagnostics, and routine operations so our engineers can focus on solving complex challenges rather than repetitive tasks.

new_jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager is responsible for overseeing and coordinating project management for redevelopment, modernization, and new construction projects funded through a variety of private, federal, state, and local sources, including Low-Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC). Project Manager(s) report directly to the Senior Project Manager, who provides leadership, supervision, and guidance to ensure projects are managed effectively and in accordance with Agency standards. The Senior Project Manager oversees the day-to-day planning, design, and implementation of complex development projects with assistance from specialized consultants, Project Managers, and Agency staff. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and a comprehensive understanding of construction management principles to ensure policies and procedures are followed, goals and objectives are achieved, and projects are completed efficiently, effectively, on schedule, and within approved budgets.

Responsibilities

·        Conduct funding research opportunities and innovative ideas relating to the funding of redevelopment, modernization and/or new construction projects.
·        Develop project budgets and cost estimates in collaboration with Agency consultants.
·        Manage budget status of projects throughout the project life cycle, proactively identify potential issues and recommend corrective actions.
·        Develop and maintain comprehensive pre-construction and project schedules.
·        Oversee and assist with procurement requirements, including the selection of the Architect and General Contractor.
·        Oversee and review environmental site assessments, hazmat surveys and similar third-party studies.
·        Oversee design development, ensuring cost efficiencies and alignment with project goals.
·        Coordinate with external agencies, such as the Buildings Department and Environmental Protection Department as needed.
·        Submit Zoning and Planning permit applications in collaboration with Architect and General Contractor and oversee land use process.
·        Participate in all Owner-Architect-Contractor meetings to proactively identify and resolve issues that could impact cost, schedule or quality.
·        Assist with relocation plan.
·        Visit construction sites regularly to inspect and monitor progress.
·        Manage project reporting, including field inspection reports, progress updates, cost tracking and communication with all parties involved.
·        Review, approve and transmit pay applications to the finance department.
·        Review and approve change orders with Architect and General Contractor.
·        Monitor and ensure compliance with prevailing wage requirements along with Section 3 requirements is applicable.
·        Manage timely closeout of projects including full documentation and final payments.
·        Perform other duties as required or assigned.

Qualifications

1.     Bachelor’s degree in construction management or related field preferred.
2.     OSHA 10 & OSHA 30 Construction Certification required.
3.     Valid driver’s license with clean driving record required.
